text: My cat has not swallowed any string. She is healthy. How should I store her dry food?

text: Last year my cat swallowed string. A vet treated it successfully and he is completely well now. How can I keep string toys safely out of reach?

text: If a cat swallowed string, that would be dangerous. My healthy cat has not done that. How can I store sewing supplies safely?
note: 假设风险：没有当前吞食事件 / Hypothetical ingestion, no current event

text: My cat is not struggling to breathe and is eating normally. She scratches the sofa. How can I redirect this behaviour?

text: My cat is healthy. How often should I remove deposits from the litter tray and wash the whole tray?
